tagline: Get Figma design updates and comment alerts directly in Slack
metaTitle: Figma Slack Integration: Comment and Version Alerts
metaDescription: Get Figma comment, version, and frame status alerts in Slack for only the files you choose. GAIA adds a daily design digest. See the setup steps.
intro:
Design teams share Figma files with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders who have no reliable way to know when designs change. Important comment threads go unnoticed by developers who are heads-down in Slack, causing feedback loops to stall and designs to ship without incorporating requested changes.

GAIA connects the two so design activity surfaces where the team already communicates. New comments, frame updates, and version publishes appear as notifications in the right channel, ensuring stakeholders stay informed and feedback gets actioned quickly.

useCases.title: Comment notifications in Slack
useCases.description: When a comment is added to a file, GAIA posts a notification to the channel with the commenter name, comment text, and a direct link to the frame. Feedback reaches the channel without manual forwarding.

useCases.title: Design version published alerts
useCases.description: When a designer publishes a new version, GAIA notifies the product and engineering channels. Stakeholders know a design is ready for review without polling the design files.

useCases.title: Frame status change notifications
useCases.description: When a frame is tagged as 'Ready for Development,' GAIA alerts the engineering channel. Handoffs happen automatically without a separate message.

useCases.title: Daily design activity digest
useCases.description: GAIA posts a morning summary of yesterday's activity, covering new comments, resolved threads, and version changes, to the design channel. The team starts each day aligned.

howItWorks.step: Connect Figma and Slack to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with both accounts. It monitors the files and projects you specify for activity.
Specify which projects send notifications to which channels and which event types to include. GAIA filters noise so only meaningful activity is surfaced.
Events matching your rules are formatted and posted to the channel in real time. Teams get full context including file name, frame name, and a deep link.

faqs.question: Can I receive notifications for only specific Figma files?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA lets you select individual files or entire projects to monitor. Unrelated files produce no noise in the channels.

faqs.question: Does GAIA notify the specific person mentioned in a comment?
faqs.answer: Yes. If a comment mentions a team member with @, GAIA can DM them so they are personally notified of the mention.

faqs.question: Can developers reply to comments from Slack?
faqs.answer: GAIA can post replies back to the comment threads on behalf of a connected user. Responding to feedback without leaving the channel is possible with this setup.
